instruction: Today is my daughter's birthday. Venmo her thrice the money I sent her on her last birthday, privately, with a description note, "Many happy returns of the day!". Then leave her a phone text message, "Happy Birthday daughter! Looking forward to meet you soon!".
notes: Two apps plus supervisor. The daughter's email, phone number and birthday are discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship=daughter); the last-birthday gift amount is discovered via venmo.show_transactions(user_email=daughter email), filtering the response to the transaction sent on her birthday last year; the new amount is three times that value (modeled by the static `thrice` relation between two amount objects). The venmo transaction must be private with the given description, and the text message is ordered after the Venmo payment via the `(venmo-sent ?p)` precondition ('Then'). supervisor-complete-task carries only task-record parameters (no API arguments since no answer is asked), mirrors the goal conjunction, and is forced last by `(not (task-completed))` on all other actions.

plan: (venmo-create-transaction daughter-email amount-thrice-last-birthday phone-token note-many-happy-returns-of-the-day private-true daughter amount-last-birthday birthday-transaction)
(supervisor-complete-task birthday-transaction daughter amount-thrice-last-birthday note-many-happy-returns-of-the-day private-true message-happy-birthday-daughter)
